title: Truthfulness of God
definition: The truthfulness of God means that God is true in Himself and truthful in all He reveals, promises, commands, and judges.
summary: God cannot lie and is the source of all truth.
christFocus: Jesus is the truth made known, revealing the Father's truth and fulfilling His Word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is true. He does not deceive, misunderstand, exaggerate, or fail to keep His Word. Truth is grounded in His character.

Because God is truthful, Scripture is trustworthy, His promises are certain, His warnings are serious, and His judgments are right.

Jesus reveals the truth of God personally. He is the way, the truth, and the life, and He speaks what is true.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: In a world of lies, confusion, and shifting definitions, the truthfulness of God matters because it gives believers a firm foundation.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Measure every claim by God's truth. Reject lies that contradict His Word, and speak truth in love because you belong to the truthful God.
